title: This is an ok organizer.  If you have lightweight fruit or items this might work out well for you.
text:
This is an ok organizer. If you have lightweight fruit or items this might work out well for you.. This is a nice triple basket set. It looks nice, but not very functional.

I'm only giving it 3 stars, because you can only put small fruit in the baskets and they tilt off balance when you put fruit in them. The bottom basket hits the counter top, when it has fruit in it. It could have been a little higher.
